# A09-S200: Correspondence

Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

Below I have cut out some of the “phrases” that seem to make sense for our application. What do you think?

Support for the production of new works for exhibitions in Denmark and abroad.
Note that only artists can apply for support for work production.

The applied project is local or international network-creating
The applied project is innovative
A written agreement can for example be an email from the exhibition venue or the organizer confirming the exhibition and the period of the exhibition.
